basis: KIF1A neurodegenerative spectrum; optic atrophy with visual impairment occurs in approximately 40-50% of reported KAND patients.

decisions.ocular: involved: functionally significant optic atrophy affects approximately 40-50% of reported KAND patients.

basis: Congenital gastrointestinal B12-binding protein deficiency causes cobalamin malabsorption and megaloblastic anemia; neurologic damage has no established qualifying frequency.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: absent gastric intrinsic factor is a defining gastrointestinal secretory defect causing cobalamin malabsorption.

basis: Defining radial-ray/diaphragmatic, cardiac and omphalocele defects; pulmonary hypoplasia accompanies congenital diaphragmatic hernia in substantially more than 30%.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pulmonary hypoplasia is common (>30%) with the syndrome's defining congenital diaphragmatic hernia.

basis: Destructive arterial invasion defines the infection; sinusitis and skin infection each occur in 30-79%. Ocular, CNS and gastrointestinal manifestations are occasional (5-29%).

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: the definition identifies destructive arterial invasion with embolization and tissue necrosis as characteristic disease pathology.

basis: IRF4-related antibody deficiency; isolated inflammatory findings in single assessed patients do not establish >=30% prevalence. Recurrent infections are separate diseases.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: large-intestinal inflammation is reported in one assessed patient; this does not establish >=30% prevalence across the disorder.
decisions.dermatologic: none: dermatitis is documented in one assessed patient; premature graying in 3/3 does not establish functionally damaging skin disease.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: synovial hyperplasia is documented in one assessed patient, without evidence of >=30% prevalence; arthralgia alone is insufficient.

basis: Herniation of intracranial contents through a congenital occipital skull defect; both CNS displacement and the cranial bone defect define the condition.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: an occipital skull defect is an essential structural component of the malformation.

basis: Inherited amyloid disorder with corneal and nerve disease; skin disease 80-99%. Hearing, salivary and cardiac involvement (30-79%) omitted by cap; severe renal disease uncommon overall.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: arrhythmias occur in 30-79%, but more prevalent skin disease takes the remaining place under the four-axis cap.
decisions.dermatologic: involved: cutis laxa and other persistent cutaneous amyloid manifestations are very frequent (80-99%).
decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: hereditary gelsolin amyloidosis is an inherited disorder of protein processing and amyloid accumulation.

basis: Site-unspecified mature cystic teratoma is predominantly ovarian. Epidermal differentiation does not establish skin origin; cutaneous and CNS disease are site-specific subtypes.

decisions.dermatologic: none: epidermal lining describes histology, not organ of origin; cutaneous lesions do not represent most patients across this predominantly gonadal umbrella.

basis: Chronic cognitive dysfunction supports neurologic classification; muscle/joint pain and other multisystem symptoms do not establish direct damage to additional organs.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: myalgia and arthralgia are symptom domains without established direct muscle or joint injury.

basis: Congenital neuromuscular-junction dysfunction with defining structural abnormalities in skeletal myofibers; this is not autoimmune myasthenia.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: tubular aggregates are defining skeletal-myofiber pathology in this specific syndrome, rather than weakness alone.
